en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc is hiring Class A regional dry van drivers in the Midwest. Earn $1,600–$1,900 per week and get home weekly. Health, dental, and vision insurance included. Two years of experience and age 23+ required. Join our team.
en.headline: Home weekly. Apply today.
